title: Manor Born: big spaces, small community.
videoTitle: PROPERTY REVIEW #159 | RM 2.7 MIL BUNGALOW IN MANOR BORN, IPOH
excerpt: A generous bungalow, a mountain backdrop, and the everyday compromises behind an exclusive address.
takeaways: A central courtyard brings light and air into the home.
A separate basement creates a distinct working zone.
The highway and compact shared spaces deserve attention.

sections.heading: A different side of Ipoh
paragraphs: In his return to the town where he was born, Sean explores Manor Born, a strata landed development within The Dales. The attraction is the combination of substantial indoor space and hills around the neighbourhood. Reaching a home involves passing through two guardhouses, giving the development a particularly tucked-away character.

sections.heading: Where the design earns its space
paragraphs: Sean's episode notes single out the courtyard for improving daylight and ventilation. He also appreciates the basement: it separates work from family life, while carefully positioned windows bring daylight into the workspace.

The accompanying Pokok.Asia review describes 18 homes and a reviewed layout with eight bedrooms and eight bathrooms. Shared facilities include a swimming pool, gym and barbecue area. These are details from the original coverage, rather than a current property listing.

sections.heading: The trade-offs outside the front door
paragraphs: The same write-up raises concerns about highway noise, a narrow approach and limited space around the internal roads and landscaping. Sean's own notes also find the common facilities less compelling than the home and its surroundings. The contrast is useful: generous private space does not automatically mean equally generous communal space.

closing: Read the original review as a starting point for understanding the design. A present-day viewing would be needed to assess condition, maintenance and noise.
sourceNote: Based on Sean's published video notes and Pokok.Asia's accompanying review. Full video captions were unavailable; this is a concise source-based summary.
